reason: The patch adds GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE and three new scopes to AdminPermissionsSchema (server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:56,69-71,79), but AdminPermissionsSchema.init() returns early when realm.getAdminPermissionsClient() != null (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:246-252) before creating scopes and resource-type resources (AdminPermissionsSchema.java:264-279). No migration in DefaultMigrationManager (model/storage-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/storage/datastore/DefaultMigrationManager.java:83-126) or in this patch backfills them for existing admin-permissions clients, leaving GroupPermissionsV2.hasPermission() (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionsV2.java:144-147) to pass a null resource to policyStore.findByResource().
